valuation.ps_withheld_reason: Withheld: the FY2025 revenue row on file, 157,643,000,000, is exactly the period-matched source's NET INTEREST INCOME (157,643,000,000) while the same row's own adjacent FY2024 cell on file (180,523,000,000) is the wider total-income line, so the denominator is a different line from its own neighbouring year and the P/S is not a valuation of the bank's revenue. A blank is honest; a ratio built on an input that cannot be verified is not a valuation.
